claude_proposed_widenings.name: subclass_choice
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The unit's entire mechanic is a permanent character-progression choice made at level-up: the player selects a subclass archetype, and that archetype grants features for the rest of the character's career. No existing ClassFeatureMechanics family covers this — the only family is 'activation', which requires activationCost, resource (UseCountResource), resetCadence, and a ClassFeatureEffect (grant_extra_action | heal_hp). None of those fields exist for a subclass-choice gate. A new family (e.g. 'subclass_choice') is needed that records the class, the level at which the choice is made, and (optionally) a reference to the available archetypes.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain a Warlock subclass of your choice. The Fiend Patron subclass is detailed after this class's description. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Warlock levels. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass's features that are of your Warlock level or lower.
